definitions: A built-in object that provides a way to represent whole numbers larger than 2^53 - 1, which is the largest number JavaScript can reliably represent with the Number primitive.
A numeric primitive in JavaScript that can represent integers with arbitrary precision.
examples: You can create a BigInt by appending n to the end of an integer literal.
Operations on BigInt values are similar to those on regular numbers.
BigInts are not strictly equal to Numbers.
